observation: Read the full candidate. The opening names local/global coupling as the difficulty and explicitly assumes human population/civilization as the dominant driver. Firstly defines nodes, adjacency links and transmitted signals; Secondly builds local factor interactions, health measures and nodal state updates; Thirdly connects active states and diffusion to a global health measure. The two stated tipping values refer to different levels and should remain separately scoped. The final paragraph links practical use to data/parameter requirements, then policy scenarios, sensitivity and critical network elements. It preserves both a robustness expectation and explicit lack of data to verify correctness, plus AHP subjectivity. Thus intended usefulness is not empirical validation. The definition sentence is broken between geographic and adjacentrelation; source paragraph recovery is needed. No network/formula correctness or source completeness accepted.
